text: maṇibhaddasuttaṃ [811] ekaṃ samayaṃ bhagavā magadhesu viharati maṇimāḷake cetiye maṇibhaddassa yakkhassa bhavane . [812] atha kho maṇibhaddo yakkho yena bhagavā tenupasaṅkami upasaṅkamitvā bhagavato santike imaṃ gāthaṃ abhāsi satimato sadā bhaddaṃ satimā sukhamedhati satimato suve seyyo verā ca parimuccatīti 1 . satimato sadā bhaddaṃ satimā sukhamedhati satimato suve seyyo verā na parimuccatīti . [813] yassa sabbamahorattiṃ 2 ahiṃsāya rato mano mettaṃso 3 sabbabhūtesu verantassa na kenacīti . pañcamaṃ
